items.headline: Manchester United suffer 2-0 defeat to Hull City in Premier League opening
items.summary: Hull City stunned Manchester United with a 2-0 victory in the season opener, with goals from Semi Ajayi and Nobel Mendy.

items.headline: Youri Tielemans completes Manchester United move from Aston Villa
items.summary: Manchester United activated a release clause to sign midfielder Youri Tielemans from Aston Villa on a five-year contract.
